notes.title: 12/08 Update
notes.content: Due to popular demand, the leaderboard has been expanded to 100 slots, and 2 new achievements were added, spread wisely!

notes.title: 04/08 Update
notes.content:
After the unexpected popularity, I've added 10 extra slots to the leaderboard to allow more people to get represented and compete for the top spots.

Bug fixes and small quality-of-life changes.

notes.title: 03/08 Update
notes.content: Removed the ability for players to change the name submitted to the leaderboard to avoid the unfortunate situation that took place today. The game will now use your steam name as the leaderboard name.
